about: Country cards for lives born in Philippines. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Philippines (PH) ===================== OFWs: an estimated 2.16 million Overseas Filipino Workers in 2023 (PSA Survey on Overseas Filipinos, via Philstar); placement fees may not exceed one month's basic salary, and none for domestic workers (DMW; PNA). Pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: An agency offers a three-year contract abroad at about {a} a year. About 2.16 million Filipinos worked overseas in 2023. Placement fees can’t exceed one month’s pay, and domestic workers pay none.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份三年的海外合约，年薪约{a}。2023年约有216万菲律宾人在海外工作。中介费不得超过一个月的工资，家政工完全不用付。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份三年的海外合約，年薪約{a}。2023年約有216萬菲律賓人在海外工作。中介費不得超過一個月的薪水，家政工完全不用付。

events.src: Paluwagan: an informal rotating savings group; about 4% of adults save this way (BSP, via Moneymax). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Officemates start a paluwagan: everyone pays a fixed amount every payday, and each payday one member takes the whole pot.

zh..x: 办公室同事开了一个互助会（paluwagan）：每个发薪日大家交固定金额，每次由一人拿走全部会钱。

zht..x: 辦公室同事開了一個互助會（paluwagan）：每個發薪日大家交固定金額，每次由一人拿走全部會錢。

events.src: Typhoons: about 20 tropical cyclones enter the Philippine Area of Responsibility each year, 8 or 9 crossing the country (PAGASA). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: About 20 tropical cyclones enter the Philippine area each year, and 8 or 9 cross the country. Your home is in their path.

zh..x: 每年约有20个热带气旋进入菲律宾责任区，其中8到9个会穿越国土。你家正在它们的路径上。

zht..x: 每年約有20個熱帶氣旋進入菲律賓責任區，其中8到9個會穿越國土。你家正在它們的路徑上。

events.src: Pag-IBIG MP2: 7.10% tax-free dividends for 2024 (Pag-IBIG Fund, via ABS-CBN and Philstar); a five-year program. With 3% inflation, about 4% real: an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('mp2', { amt: a, until: age + 5 }, { rate: .04, lock: age + 5 }, 'trk.mp2')

en..x: Pag-IBIG’s MP2 is a five-year savings programme; it paid a tax-free 7.1% dividend for 2024.
en..mp2.s: About {a} a year for 5 years. About 4% a year after inflation.

zh..x: Pag-IBIG的MP2是五年期储蓄计划；2024年派发免税股息7.1%。
zh..mp2.s: 每年约{a}，存5年。扣除通胀后每年约4%。

zht..x: Pag-IBIG的MP2是五年期儲蓄計畫；2024年派發免稅股息7.1%。
zht..mp2.s: 每年約{a}，存5年。扣除通膨後每年約4%。

events.src: PhilHealth: 5% of income for direct contributors in 2025, floor ₱10,000 (₱500 a month) (PhilHealth Advisory 2025-0002): ₱6,000 a year ≈ 0.057 of the game's typical wage (₱105,000). Share of bills covered is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: As a self-employed member you pay PhilHealth yourself: 5% of your income in 2025, at least ₱500 a month.
en..join.h: It pays about half of your hospital bills.

zh..x: 自雇会员要自己缴国家健康保险（PhilHealth）：2025年是收入的5%，每月至少₱500。

zht..x: 自僱會員要自己繳國家健康保險（PhilHealth）：2025年是收入的5%，每月至少₱500。

events.src: SSS voluntary members: 15% of the monthly salary credit (from ₱5,000) from Jan 2025, all paid by the member; 120 monthly contributions earn a lifetime pension (Manila Bulletin; Grant Thornton). ₱9,000 a year ≈ 0.086; the pension (≈ ₱2,400 a month, ≈ 0.27) is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Self-employed and voluntary members pay the whole SSS contribution themselves: 15% of the monthly salary credit they choose, from 2025. After 120 monthly contributions you get a pension for life.
en..pay.s: About {a} a year; a pension of about {b} a year from 60.

zh..x: 自雇和自愿会员要自己缴全部社会保障（SSS）费：2025年起是所选月薪基数的15%。缴满120个月就能终身领养老金。
zh..pay.s: 每年约{a}；60岁起每年领约{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 自僱和自願會員要自己繳全部社會保障（SSS）費：2025年起是所選月薪基數的15%。繳滿120個月就能終身領退休金。
zht..pay.s: 每年約{a}；60歲起每年領約{b}的退休金。

events.src: 13th-month pay: one-twelfth of basic salary, paid by 24 December (Presidential Decree 851).

en..x: By law your 13th-month pay, a twelfth of a year’s basic salary, must be paid by 24 December.

zh..x: 依法第十三个月薪水，即全年基本工资的十二分之一，必须在12月24日前发放。

zht..x: 依法第十三個月薪水，即全年基本薪水的十二分之一，必須在12月24日前發放。

events.src: Pag-IBIG housing loans: 5.75% (1-year) and 6.25% (3-year) repricing in 2025; the Affordable Housing Program charges 3% for low-income members, for up to 30 years (Malaya; Tribune, 2025). Real rates (about 0% and 3%) and prices are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: buyAt(.45 * P, { dp: .05, fee: .02, r: 0, n: 30, lk: 'trk.ph_ahp', fixed: true })

opts.ok: liq >= .13 * .8 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.104 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(.8 * P, { dp: .1, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.flat' })

en..x: Pag-IBIG housing loans charged 5.75–6.25% a year in 2025; under its Affordable Housing Program, low-income members can buy socialised housing at 3% for up to 30 years. A small home costs {p}; socialised housing about {q}.
en..ahp.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 30 years.
en..no: Your income is above the programme’s limit.

zh..x: 2025年Pag-IBIG房贷利率为每年5.75–6.25%；在可负担住房计划下，低收入会员可以用3%的利率买社会住房，最长30年。一间小房子要{p}；社会住房约{q}。
zh..no: 你的收入超过计划的上限。

zht..x: 2025年Pag-IBIG房貸利率為每年5.75–6.25%；在可負擔住房計畫下，低收入會員可以用3%的利率買社會住房，最長30年。一間小房子要{p}；社會住房約{q}。
zht..no: 你的收入超過計畫的上限。
